description: info-clock-rate-v1 (P9 AL-CLOCK, lit [28][29]): aim-partial-v5's theta per name from its information clock: a member whose ea_days_since (sessions since its latest primary earnings announcement's reaction session; --fields) is in [0, 21] moves at theta_f = 1 - 2^(-C/5) at cadence C (two-speed-v1's fast rate), every other member (a NaN clock included) at theta_s = --trade-fraction, which must be .05; needs --rule aim-partial-v5; one rate vector per decision for every book, so --book-workers N runs
